pages.text: $(bold)Plant Manipulation$(): to command flora is the art. $(br2)$(bold)Forward activation$(): press the technique release key to open the selection screen, pick one of $(bold)Roots$() and $(bold)Cursed Seed$(), then begin charging; $(bold)aim at an enemy and press the release key once more$() to cast (cost follows the formula (1 - Affinity/100) × (10 + Output×5)). If it is not released within 15 seconds of charging it dissipates on its own; if it misses, the charge is kept and you may re-aim. $(br2)$(bold)Reversal$(): press the technique reversal key (F) to directly absorb the life energy of plants within a 5×5×5 area around you and convert it into Cursed Energy, at no cost.

$(bold)Roots$(): $(bold)Sweet Berry Bushes$() grow under the target's feet and in the 2 blocks around it: they are born as young shoots and $(bold)reach full stage within 2 seconds$() (no fruit, no sweet berries dropped), lasting 3 seconds: $(li)enemies inside take cursed technique damage every 0.75 seconds (shared damage base × 20% per tick, applying wand boosts and Cursed Core material traits) and stack slowness$(li)breaking the bushes drops nothing, and while active they are $(bold)unbreakable / unpickable$() (no quick escape)$(li)after 3 seconds the original blocks are restored automatically$(br2)$(bold)Cursed Seed$(): give the target $(bold)Cursed Seed Parasitism$() (160 + Output×16 ticks): $(li)attack damage reduced by 40%$(li)Cursed Energy capacity and Cursed Energy Output each drop one stage (never below 1)$(li)Cursed Energy Affinity reduced by 60 (never below 0)

$(bold)Reversal · Flora Drain$(): absorb nearby plants and convert them into Cursed Energy: $(li)Grass Block → Coarse Dirt: +1 Cursed Energy$(li)breaking grass (short grass / fern / tall grass / large fern): +3 Cursed Energy, no drops$(li)breaking saplings: +3 Cursed Energy, no drops$(li)breaking any flowers: +3 Cursed Energy, no drops$(li)breaking any leaves: +8 Cursed Energy, no drops$(br2)Blocks are matched by tag (sapling / flower / leaf tags) within a 5×5×5 area centered on yourself. Great for refilling Cursed Energy quickly in forests and grasslands; in open ground with no plants you gain nothing.
